scope: Conditional planar ZP saturation search on the existing FGH/GHF prototype; not historical FGH saturation values.
conductivity: Parker neutral-gas kappa=2500 sqrt(T) erg cm^-1 K^-1 s^-1, newly assumed for this diagnostic; not recovered from FGH1969
chemistry_closure: Instantaneous local ionization equilibrium from two_phase.py; P/kB=(n0+ne)T, n0=H+He nuclei, nH=0.9 n0.
limitations: A finite pressure and temperature search cannot rule out an unsampled root or a root outside the adopted domain. Depleted warm branches remain prototype extensions. Missing historical rates are not recovered or fitted.
